title: Pilot vouches for Marzulli's source using details he held back
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Pilot vouches for Marzulli's source using details he held back, about after 2005 at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he purposely withheld certain details from the story so that if somebody comes forward trying to add additional information, he could vet whether or not they're telling the truth and he said that guy is telling the truth.

plain: A filmmaker, Tim Alberino, tells of a source who came forward to an author named L.A. Marzulli some time after 2005, and of a pilot who checked that source's story. According to Alberino, the pilot had kept certain details of his own account secret so he could test anyone who later claimed to know more, and the pilot said this man was telling the truth. Alberino tells it because it would mean the source's claims were confirmed by someone who knew details only a real witness would know.
